subject: Hosted API - baseline guarantee & flexible starter commits
messages:
From: Abby Chen <abby@acme-ai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@acme-ai.com>, procurement@acme-ai.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: minimum monthly spend & flexible commit options for Hosted API

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — Acme AI is evaluating hosted inference providers for a pilot (NLP search + reranking) and we need clarity on entry-level commercial options. A few questions up front:

- Do you have a published minimum monthly commitment for the hosted API, or a recommended starter band for small customers?
- If we do a small commit (e.g., $1k–$5k / mo), can unused dollars roll over to the next month?
- Is there an alternative to a strict commit — e.g., a nominal monthly guarantee + pay-as-you-go with tiered discounts once we hit thresholds?
- How do discount tiers apply for bursty usage patterns where monthly volume varies 3–5x?

For context: pilot expected to run 3 months, estimated average consumption ~80M tokens / mo in month 1 (very bursty), could grow to 200M tokens / mo if evaluation looks good. We don’t need Dedicated capacity yet — Hosted API only.

I attached our RFP excerpt. Procurement is cc’d — they’ll need a path that doesn’t require long-term commitment but still gives predictable pricing for budgeting.

Appreciate any quick guidance — if easier, we can set up a 30-min call.

— Abby
Abby Chen
Head of Product
Acme AI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Abby Chen <abby@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: minimum monthly spend & flexible commit options for Hosted API

Hi Abby — welcome, and thanks for the RFP excerpt. Short answers up front, then specific options:

1) Published minimum: we do not enforce a hard enterprise-only minimum for the Hosted API — we support pay-as-you-go with self-serve onboarding. For customers who want predictability, we offer starter commit bands.

2) Starter commit band (low-touch): typical starter is $2k/month (3 month rolling recommended), which gives a modest discount vs PAYG and prioritizes capacity. We can offer monthly rollover of up to 50% of unused credits for two months on starter bands.

3) Hybrid alternative: nominal monthly guarantee (e.g., $500/mo) + PAYG at a committed discount band once you cross a threshold in a given month. This is often used by early-stage customers to avoid long-term lock-in but still get discount pricing for bursts.

4) Burst handling: discount tiers are calculated on monthly consumption; for highly variable months we can implement a smoothing policy across a 3-month window for billing true-up (helpful to avoid sharp swings).

If that sounds helpful, Rishi (cc’d) can share an example rate card and two sample quotes (starter band vs nominal guarantee + PAYG). Monica from CS can advise on operational considerations (rate limits, warmup) during the pilot.

Would you like a formal quote or a quick call later this week?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Abby Chen <abby@acme-ai.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: minimum monthly spend & flexible commit options for Hosted API

Abby / team — attaching a short starter-rate sheet and two hypothetical examples to illustrate cost at your noted volumes (attached: redwood-pricing-starter-bands-2026.pdf). Key points and options we can propose formally:

A) Pay-as-you-go (no commit)
   - No monthly minimum; standard PAYG per-token rates apply.
   - Best if you want zero commitment; pricing has no smoothing, so monthly bill can vary.

B) Starter commit band (recommended for pilots)
   - $2k / month commitment (3-month rolling by default).
   - 10% effective discount on per-token rates versus PAYG within the committed bucket.
   - Up to 50% unused-credit rollover for up to two months.

C) Nominal guarantee + PAYG hybrid
   - $500 / month nominal baseline to secure capacity and a lower entry barrier.
   - PAYG beyond baseline billed at tiered discounted rates once thresholds met.
   - We can apply 3-month smoothing on billing to average out spikes for discount tier calculation.

D) Monthly true-up and short-term elasticity
   - For pilots with big variance, we can set a temporary smoothing window and waive overage penalties for two months while we monitor consumption.

E) Commercial flex: for customers who convert to Dedicated later, starter commits can be credited toward the initial Dedicated commitment within a 6–12 month window.

If you can confirm expected monthly token range (low / expected / high) and whether you need EU data residency, I’ll draft a HubSpot proposal and a DocuSign-ready quote. Also note: starter commits are month-to-month; we can attach a simple addendum for rollover terms.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-starter-bands-2026.pdf

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, ISVs & Startups
Redwood Inference
From: Abby Chen <abby@acme-ai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-ai.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: minimum monthly spend & flexible commit options for Hosted API

Thanks Rishi — that framing is helpful. We’re leaning toward the nominal guarantee + PAYG hybrid to avoid overcommitting while securing predictable unit economics for spikes. Numbers we can commit to for the pilot:

- Low: 50M tokens / mo
- Expected: 100M tokens / mo
- High (spike): 300M tokens / mo

No EU residency required for the pilot (US-only). Procurement would prefer a month-to-month agreement for the pilot with the 3-month smoothing for billing tiers and a 50% rollover cap. Can you send a HubSpot quote and a short one-page addendum with the smoothing and rollover language for legal? Also include the trial credit you mentioned on the call (we discussed a $5k credit).

If possible please send before EOD Monday — procurement wants to review and sign a pilot SOW quickly.

Thanks — Abby
